'''Mercedes Vila Juárez''' (born 1975) is a Spanish material science researcher. She is the [[chief technology officer]] (CTO) and co-founder of [[BioTech Foods]] SL.<ref name="Ethicameat">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ethicameat.com/|title=Ethicameat – Good for you, better for all}}</ref>

== Path ==
Mercedes Vila Juárez Vila was born in [[Madrid|Madrid, Spain]]. graduated in Physics from the [[Autonomous University of Madrid]] with a doctorate in Materials Physics, in December 2003.

She did five years of international post-doctoral experience, funded by a Marie Curie Intra-European fellowship and several national programs of investigation, to develop biomaterials surfaces using physical and chemical methods.

In 2008, she incorporated as a [[Ramón y Cajal (scholarship)|Ramón y Cajal Investigator]] at the faculty of Pharmacy of the [[Complutense University of Madrid]], in one of the most prestigious European groups of Nanomedice and regenerative [[Tissue engineering]], with the funding of an ERG-Marie Curie Action grant (2008–2010).<ref name="uno">{{Cite web|url=http://www.ua.pt/research/mercedes_vila|title=Research@UA › Mercedes Vila|access-date=29 May 2016}}</ref> During this period, she developed materials for the reconstruction of the loss of [[bone mass]], with what promised to improve the quality of life of patients with some injuries, and pathologies such as [[bone cancer]] or [[osteoporosis]].<ref name="lo">{{Cite web|url=http://www.culturabiotec.com/2011/02/prada/|title=La investigación "se viste de Prada" {{!}} Cultura Biotec|access-date=29 May 2016}}</ref><ref name="wo">{{cite web|url=http://www.woman.es/galerias/lifestyle/la-ciencia-en-femenino?id=4|title=Mercedes Vila|website=woman.es|date=25 March 2011}}</ref>

Her work has focused on understanding materials-cells interactions, and the design and applications of [[nanoparticle]]s based on [[graphene oxide]] for cancer hyperthermia. <!-- for vectors for the hyperthermia of tumors, the  and the study of the stimulation of the cellular growth by means of the utilisation of external physical stimuli on carbon based systems -->.<ref name="uno"/>

In November 2010, she was awarded, with four other scientists ([[Isabel Lastres Becker]], [[Ana Briones Alonso]], [[Elena Ramírez Parra]] and [[María Antonia Herrero]]), the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science]], with an endowment of €15000 to reward the work, for women younger than 40 years, to support woman in science.<ref name="lo"/><ref name="pais">{{Cite news |url= http://sociedad.elpais.com/sociedad/2010/11/18/actualidad/1290034810_850215.html |title= Cinco científicas de la vida españolas reciben las becas L'Oréal-Unesco |access-date= 30 May 2016 |newspaper= El País |date=18 Nov 2010 |language=es}}</ref>

In 2013, she was Principal Investigator at the [[University of Aveiro]], becoming laboratory coordinator for applications of carbon in nanomedicine.<ref>{{Cite web |url= http://www.graphene-applications-2014.com/4/speakers/178/mercedes-vila-juarez/ |title= Graphene Supply, Application & Commercialisation 2014 – Mercedes Vila Juarez |access-date= 26 July 2016 |last=Limited |first=DUSZA |website= www.graphene-applications-2014.com }}</ref> In 2015, while keeping her appointment as professor at the [[University of Aveiro]], she transferred to industry in 2015 as Scientific Director of Coating Technologies S.L.-CTECHnano,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ctechnano.com/coating-technologies/|title=CTECHnano &#124; Custom and innovative ALD solutions and applications|website=CTECHNANO}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url= http://orcid.org/0000-0002-8473-0881 |title= M. Vila (0000-0002-8473-0881) – ORCID {{!}} Connecting Research and Researchers |access-date= 13 May 2016 |last=ORCID |website= orcid.org }}</ref>

She co-founded [[BioTech Foods]] in February 2017, being the CTO of the company.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.biotech-foods.com/|title=Biotech Foods develops technology to produce cultured meat|website=BioTech-Foods}}</ref><ref name="Ethicameat" /><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ticbeat.com/entrevistas/biotech-foods-carne-etica/ |website=ticbeat.com |title=Mercedes Vila (Biotech Foods): "La carne ética mejorará el bienestar humano y medioambiental" |language=es |trans-title=Mercedes Vila (Biotech Foods): "Ethical meat will improve human and environmental well-being" |date=28 October 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210704124745/https://www.ticbeat.com/entrevistas/biotech-foods-carne-etica/ |archive-date=4 July 2021}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 2006: Marie Curie IntraEuropean Fellowship. European Commission
* 2008: Marie Curie Reintegration Grant. European Commission
* 2010: Women in Science Award. L'Oreal Foundation-UNESCO
* 2017: Marie Curie Society & Enterprise. European Commission
